high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of a pair of Nike sneakers inside an open shoebox. The sneakers are predominantly white with gray accents and feature a distinctive wavy design on the side. The laces are white with orange tips, and there is a small red tag attached to one of the laces that reads "MAX." The Nike swoosh logo is prominently displayed in black on both shoes. The shoebox is partially open, revealing the sneakers and some of the packaging materials inside. The box appears to be placed on a shelf or a display stand, as indicated by the metallic edge above it.
